info.title: BrownSync Read API
info.description: Read-only API over the BrownSync canonical schema (DATA_CONTRACT.md §3). Consumed by apps/web and, later, the SwiftUI client via codegen.

get.summary: Canonical events, filterable by time window, bbox, category, and text
get.description: Time filtering is overlap semantics. Defaults: from=now, to=from+7 days. bbox is 'w,s,e,n' (lng/lat). q ranks substring hits above trigram-fuzzy hits.

get.summary: One event with org and place expanded
A place plus everything happening there around instant `at`
get.description: Events overlapping [at, at+24h] and course meetings in session at `at`. Default at=now.

get.summary: One organization with upcoming and past events
Course meetings in session at instant `at`
get.description: Server expands weekly day patterns + America/New_York times against the term calendar. Default at=now.

get.summary: Default live view: events in progress or starting within 2h, meetings, counts

200.description: Latest run + latest ok per source; 'never' if no runs
